This script reads in these data: MAR_pressure_groupings_Nov132026.csv

and converts them into pressure weights for the main groups that will be differentially affected by the pressures.


```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(here)

mar <- read_csv(here("FP/v2026/FP_Scores_1.1/MAR_Scores_1.1/MAR_pressure_groupings_Nov132026.csv"))

head(mar)
table(mar$Mariculture_Sector)

# check NAs
mar %>%
  filter(is.na(Mariculture_Sector)) %>%
  count(Mariculture_Sector, sort = TRUE)

mar <- mar %>%
  filter(!is.na(Mariculture_Sector)) %>%
  filter(year >= 2018) %>%
  group_by(Mariculture_Sector) %>%
  summarize(tonnes = sum(total_est_production_mt)) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(tonnes)) %>%
  mutate(mar_weight = tonnes/total) %>%
  select(mar_category=Mariculture_Sector, mar_weight)

write_csv(mar, here("FP/v2026/FP_Scores_1.1/MAR_Scores_1.1/MAR_pressure_weightings.csv"))

```
